gmail_banner_message_title.description: Gmail add-on: title of the banner PGP Tools shows above an encrypted message inside Gmail.

gmail_banner_message_action.description: Gmail add-on: button on the encrypted-message banner. Opens the PGP Tools side panel and decrypts there. Keep short (one word).

gmail_banner_signed_title.description: Gmail add-on: title of the banner above a PGP cleartext-signed message in Gmail.

gmail_banner_signed_action.description: Gmail add-on: button on the signed-message banner. Keep short (one word).

gmail_banner_key_title.description: Gmail add-on: title of the banner above a PGP public key someone pasted into an email.

gmail_banner_key_action.description: Gmail add-on: button on the public-key banner. Opens the import screen in the side panel. Keep short.

gmail_banner_clipped_title.message: Encrypted message, cut short by Gmail
gmail_banner_clipped_title.description: Gmail add-on: banner title when Gmail clipped a long email so only part of the encrypted block is on screen.

gmail_banner_clipped_action.description: Gmail add-on: button that opens Gmail's own full view of a clipped message in a new tab. Gmail's English UI uses the same words.

gmail_opening.description: Gmail add-on: button label while the side panel is being opened.

gmail_notice_opened.message: Opened in the PGP Tools side panel.
gmail_notice_opened.description: Gmail add-on: banner note after a successful click. Fades after a few seconds.

gmail_notice_panel_failed.message: The side panel didn't open. Click the PGP Tools icon in your toolbar to see it.
gmail_notice_panel_failed.description: Gmail add-on: note when Chrome refused to open the side panel.

gmail_notice_not_enabled.message: Gmail access is turned off. Turn it on in PGP Tools settings.
gmail_notice_not_enabled.description: Gmail add-on: note when the user revoked Gmail access while this Gmail tab was still open.

gmail_notice_invalid.message: This doesn't look like a complete PGP block.
gmail_notice_invalid.description: Gmail add-on: note when the text in the email could not be read as a whole armored block.

gmail_notice_orphaned.message: PGP Tools was updated. Reload Gmail to keep using it here.
gmail_notice_orphaned.description: Gmail add-on: note when the extension was updated or reloaded and this Gmail tab still runs the old copy.

gmail_compose_action.description: Gmail add-on: button next to Gmail's Send button in a compose window. Keep short (one word).

gmail_compose_writing.description: Gmail add-on: compose button label while the user writes the message in the side panel.

gmail_compose_done.description: Gmail add-on: compose button label once the encrypted message has been put into the draft.

gmail_compose_tooltip.message: Turn encryption on: write the email in the PGP Tools side panel, and only the encrypted version goes into Gmail.
gmail_compose_tooltip.description: Gmail add-on: tooltip on the compose Encrypt button.

gmail_compose_opened.message: Write your message in the side panel. Encrypt & send puts it here encrypted.
gmail_compose_opened.description: Gmail add-on: bubble above the compose Encrypt button after the side panel opened. 'Add to Gmail' is the panel button label (gmail_insert).

gmail_strip_title.description: Side panel: title of the strip above the message box when the user is writing an email that will go back into a Gmail compose window.

gmail_strip_to.description: Side panel: who the Gmail draft is addressed to. $addresses$ is a comma-separated list of email addresses.

gmail_strip_no_recipients.message: No recipients yet. Add them here or in Gmail.
gmail_strip_no_recipients.description: Side panel: shown in the Gmail draft strip when the Gmail compose window had no recipients.

gmail_strip_dismiss.description: Side panel: accessible label of the close button on the Gmail draft strip.

gmail_strip_missing_one.message: This recipient can't read it yet:
gmail_strip_missing_one.description: Side panel: heading of the warning in the Gmail draft strip, above one email address that has no matching key. Followed by the address and a Search for key button.

gmail_strip_missing_other.description: Side panel: heading of the warning in the Gmail draft strip. $count$ is how many addresses have no key; the addresses follow, one per line, each with a Search for key button.

gmail_insert.description: Side panel: primary button after encrypting a message when the Gmail add-on is on. Replaces Download. Puts the encrypted message into the Gmail draft the user came from, or opens a new Gmail message addressed to the recipients with it in the body.

gmail_inserted_desc.message: Check it over in Gmail, then press Send.
gmail_inserted_desc.description: Side panel toast description under gmail_inserted and gmail_opened_compose.

gmail_insert_gone.description: Side panel toast when the Gmail compose window was closed before the encrypted message could be inserted.

gmail_insert_gone_desc.message: Copy the encrypted message and paste it into a new draft.
gmail_insert_gone_desc.description: Side panel toast description under gmail_insert_gone.

gmail_settings_row.description: Settings: label of the row that opens the Gmail add-on page. Product name.

gmail_settings_title.description: Settings: title of the Gmail add-on subpage.

gmail_settings_pitch.message: Read, write and send encrypted email without leaving Gmail. Messages are decrypted in place, in a PGP Tools panel inside the email that Gmail can't read; you write in the side panel, and only encrypted text and files ever go into Gmail.
gmail_settings_pitch.description: Settings: intro paragraph on the Gmail add-on page.

gmail_settings_toggle_title.description: Settings: label of the switch that turns the Gmail add-on on (asks Chrome for access to mail.google.com).

gmail_settings_toggle_desc.message: Chrome will ask to let PGP Tools read and change mail.google.com. Turning this off removes that access.
gmail_settings_toggle_desc.description: Settings: description under the Gmail add-on switch.

gmail_settings_denied.message: Chrome didn't grant access, so the add-on is still off.
gmail_settings_denied.description: Settings: shown when the user declined Chrome's permission prompt.

gmail_settings_does_title.description: Settings: heading of the list of what the Gmail add-on does.

gmail_settings_does_read.message: Shows encrypted and signed messages decrypted in place, in the email, once your key is unlocked in the side panel.
gmail_settings_does_read.description: Settings: Gmail add-on capability, first bullet.

gmail_settings_does_compose.message: Adds a lock beside Send. When it's on, you write in the side panel and Encrypt & send puts only the encrypted version into Gmail and sends it. It turns itself on when you reply to an encrypted email.
gmail_settings_does_compose.description: Settings: Gmail add-on capability, second bullet.

gmail_settings_does_recipients.message: Picks the right keys from the draft's To and Cc addresses.
gmail_settings_does_recipients.description: Settings: Gmail add-on capability, third bullet.

gmail_settings_does_attachments.message: Adds a Decrypt button to encrypted attachments, and attaches files you encrypt here to the draft.
gmail_settings_does_attachments.description: Settings, Gmail page: bullet in the 'What it does' list about attachments.

gmail_settings_never_title.description: Settings: heading of the list of guarantees for the Gmail add-on.

gmail_settings_never_plaintext.message: Decrypted text is shown only inside PGP Tools' own panel in the email. It is never written into Gmail's page, and Gmail's scripts can't read it.
gmail_settings_never_plaintext.description: Settings: Gmail add-on guarantee, first bullet.

gmail_settings_never_account.message: No Google sign-in, no Gmail API, and no servers. It only works with what is on your screen.
gmail_settings_never_account.description: Settings: Gmail add-on guarantee, second bullet.

gmail_settings_never_keys.message: Your keys never leave the side panel, and Gmail's page can't reach them.
gmail_settings_never_keys.description: Settings: Gmail add-on guarantee, third bullet.

gmail_settings_draft_note.message: With the lock on, Gmail's own text box is covered: nothing you type into Gmail can be the message, so Google never saves a plaintext draft. Anything typed before turning the lock on is carried over, and Google has already seen it.
gmail_settings_draft_note.description: Settings: caveat paragraph at the bottom of the Gmail add-on page.

gmail_settings_limits.message: Encrypted attachments (.pgp, .gpg, .asc, .age) get a Decrypt button. PGP/MIME messages open as raw text.
gmail_settings_limits.description: Settings: limitation note on the Gmail add-on page.

gmail_strip_search_key.description: Side panel: small button next to an email address with no key. Looks the address up on keys.openpgp.org in the import screen. Keep short.

gmail_strip_add_key.description: Side panel: small button next to an email address with no key, shown when online key lookups are turned off. Opens the import screen. Keep short.

gmail_opened_compose.description: Side panel toast after Add to Gmail opened a new Gmail message with the recipients and the encrypted message filled in.

gmail_frame_title.description: Gmail: title of the inline reader panel embedded in an email (also its iframe title for screen readers).

gmail_frame_decrypting.description: Gmail inline reader: heading while the side panel is decrypting the message.

gmail_frame_verifying.description: Gmail inline reader: heading while the side panel is checking a signed message.

gmail_frame_decrypted.description: Gmail inline reader: heading above a decrypted message shown in place in the email.

gmail_frame_signed.description: Gmail inline reader: heading above a signed message whose signature has been checked.

gmail_frame_locked.description: Gmail inline reader: heading when the message can't be read yet because PGP Tools is closed or locked.

gmail_frame_locked_sub.message: Unlock PGP Tools to read it here.
gmail_frame_locked_sub.description: Gmail inline reader: line under the heading when PGP Tools is closed or locked.

gmail_frame_unlock.description: Gmail inline reader: button that opens the PGP Tools side panel so the user can unlock their key; the message then appears in place.

gmail_frame_open.description: Gmail inline reader: secondary button that opens the message in the side panel (to reply, save or translate it).

gmail_frame_open_tooltip.message: Reply, save or translate it in the side panel.
gmail_frame_open_tooltip.description: Gmail inline reader: tooltip of the Open in PGP Tools button.

gmail_frame_failed.description: Gmail inline reader: heading when the side panel could not decrypt the message; a reason follows.

gmail_frame_fail_no_key.message: None of your keys can open this message.
gmail_frame_fail_no_key.description: Gmail inline reader: reason line when the message is not encrypted to any key in the vault.

gmail_frame_fail_password.message: This message needs a password. Open it in PGP Tools to enter one.
gmail_frame_fail_password.description: Gmail inline reader: reason line when the message is encrypted to a password rather than a key.

gmail_frame_fail_bad_signature.message: The signature doesn't match. This message may have been tampered with.
gmail_frame_fail_bad_signature.description: Gmail inline reader: reason line when a signature failed to verify.

gmail_frame_fail_error.message: Open it in PGP Tools to see why.
gmail_frame_fail_error.description: Gmail inline reader: reason line for any other failure (binary payload, unreadable block).

gmail_frame_unsigned.description: Gmail inline reader: line under the heading of a decrypted message that carries no signature.

gmail_frame_signer_unknown.message: Signed by a key you don't have
gmail_frame_signer_unknown.description: Gmail inline reader: line under the heading when the message is signed but the signer's key is not in the vault.

gmail_frame_signed_by.description: Gmail inline reader: line under the heading when the signature verified. $name$ is the signer's name from their key.

gmail_frame_show_original.description: Gmail inline reader: link that reveals the raw encrypted text Gmail rendered, folded away under the panel.

gmail_frame_hide_original.description: Gmail inline reader: link that folds the raw encrypted text away again.

gmail_frame_text_label.description: Gmail inline reader: accessible label of the box holding the decrypted text.

gmail_frame_unavailable.message: This page only works inside Gmail.
gmail_frame_unavailable.description: Gmail inline reader: shown when the reader page is opened on its own rather than embedded in an email.

gmail_attachment_decrypt.description: Gmail: button next to an encrypted attachment (.pgp, .gpg, .age) that opens it in PGP Tools.

gmail_attachment_open.description: Gmail: button next to an .asc attachment, which may be a message, a key or a signature.

gmail_attachment_tooltip.description: Gmail: tooltip of the attachment button. $name$ is the attachment's file name.

gmail_attachment_failed.message: Couldn't get that attachment from Gmail
gmail_attachment_failed.description: Side panel: error toast when fetching an attachment the user clicked in Gmail failed.

gmail_attachment_failed_desc.message: Download it and drop it into PGP Tools instead.
gmail_attachment_failed_desc.description: Side panel: description under the attachment error toast.

gmail_attachment_too_large.message: That attachment is too large to open here
gmail_attachment_too_large.description: Side panel: error toast when a Gmail attachment is over the size limit.

gmail_attachment_not_pgp.message: That attachment isn't a PGP or age file
gmail_attachment_not_pgp.description: Side panel: error toast when a fetched Gmail attachment is neither ciphertext nor a key.

gmail_attach.description: Side panel: primary button after encrypting files when the Gmail add-on is on. Replaces Download. Attaches the encrypted files to the Gmail draft the user came from, or to a new Gmail message.

gmail_attached.description: Side panel: success toast after encrypted files were attached to the Gmail draft.

gmail_attached_desc.message: Check it over in Gmail, then press Send.
gmail_attached_desc.description: Side panel: description under the attached toast.

gmail_encrypt_and_attach.description: Side panel: run button label while writing a Gmail draft with files staged: encrypts them and attaches the result to the draft in one go.

gmail_compose_on.description: Gmail: the lock pill beside Send while encryption is on for this compose window. Clicking it turns encryption off.

gmail_compose_tooltip_on.message: Encryption is on. The message is written in the PGP Tools side panel. Click to turn it off.
gmail_compose_tooltip_on.description: Gmail: tooltip of the lock pill while on.

gmail_compose_tooltip_off.message: Turn encryption on: write the email in the PGP Tools side panel, and only the encrypted version goes into Gmail.
gmail_compose_tooltip_off.description: Gmail: tooltip of the lock pill while off.

gmail_cover_title.description: Gmail: title of the card that stands in for the compose box while encryption is on.

gmail_cover_sub.message: Write it in the PGP Tools side panel. Nothing typed into Gmail can be the message. Files go in the panel too.
gmail_cover_sub.description: Gmail: line under the cover card's title.

gmail_cover_action.description: Gmail: button on the cover card that brings the side panel up.

gmail_cover_dropped.message: Drop files on the PGP Tools side panel instead, so they're encrypted too.
gmail_cover_dropped.description: Gmail: cover card note after a file was dropped on it (the drop was blocked).

gmail_encrypt_and_send.description: Side panel: run button label while writing a Gmail draft. Encrypts the message, puts it in the draft, and presses Gmail's Send.

gmail_sent.description: Side panel: success toast after Encrypt & send pressed Gmail's Send and the compose window closed.

gmail_sent_desc.description: Side panel: description under the sent toast.

gmail_inserted_press_send.message: Added to your Gmail draft. Press Send in Gmail.
gmail_inserted_press_send.description: Side panel: toast when the ciphertext went into the draft but Gmail did not take the Send press (it may be asking about an empty subject).

gmail_frame_reply.description: Gmail inline reader: button that opens Gmail's own reply window for this message, encrypted.

gmail_frame_reply_tooltip.message: Opens Gmail's reply, encrypted. You write it in the side panel.
gmail_frame_reply_tooltip.description: Gmail inline reader: tooltip of the Reply button.
